pages.title: Before Water Appears
pages.text: An array of pearl fragments bent the current away from its pattern. No water formed, but a glimmer remained between the copper plates.$(br2)It can become water or push a body. I call this common current $(l)aether$().

pages.title: Leave a Gap
pages.text: Keep a water source at each end and put the disruptor $(l)directly below the middle water cell$(). Scoop out an existing middle source so the water tries to fill the gap again.$(br2)An adjacent reservoir gives the glimmer somewhere to stay.

pages.title: Prepare Before Reaching In
pages.text: Touch the disruptor with an empty hand to draw a fragment. Away from confinement, it soon fades.$(br2)$(l)Prepare the other materials before extracting it.$() Return an unused fragment to a reservoir. A finished device confines its aether and stops the countdown.
